Use case: final-candidate game battlefield environment for an original Heroes of Might and Magic III / VCMI additional Targon town. Paint ONE landscape highland SIEGE BATTLEFIELD EMPTY BACKGROUND, native destination800x556, aspect~1.44:1. Original1999HeroesIII richly textured compact prerendered/painted natural scenery language, gritty native-size material detail, restrained palette, bright upper-left daylight, no cinematic framing. Camera is the original HeroesIII battlefield camera: nearly frontal elevated overview, ground extends from lower edge to high distant horizon at top~15percent. The lower85percent must be a broad reasonably FLAT CLEAR WALKABLE alpine grass/dirt battlefield with irregular muted olive grasses, weathered earthy gray-brown gravel, only tiny scattered stones/tufts near far left and right edges. No big obstacles in the center or lower fighting grid. Distant background along upper15percent: dramatic but receding pale-gray Targon mountain ridges and small snow patches, atmospheric slate-blue distance and muted sky; no gigantic cliff or mountain blocking the combat field. At right edge the terrain may rise slightly into a town terrace beyond future walls, but there must be NO WALLS, BUILDINGS, gates, towers, fortifications, ramps, trenches, moats or completed constructible architecture baked into this background: all will be separate engine layers. No people, creatures, flags, roads through the center, tile grid, checkerboard, UI, text, labels or watermarks. Native HoMM3 color/texture density and coherent light, not flat gray 3D plane, not primitive polygon mountain cones, not modern glossy art, not anime, not neon galaxy. Entire opaque frame painted edge to edge. This is original local mountain geography, not copying any existing Castle/Rampart background or skyline.
